transcript: The world of design has officially entered the intelligence era. If you ever wanted to make your app, you cannot skip this. Figma made massive AI-centric announcements at their annual event Config India 2024, and I got the front row seat. They just dropped code layers, and you can now turn any Figma design into a real, working app with a click. And it's the biggest AI moment. It's simple. Your design is not a picture anymore. It becomes real, running code right on the canvas. You can tap it, scroll it, and click every button like a real app. And this hit me hard. As a founder, I'm always testing new ideas for our products, but every experiment is slow. We design the screens, wait for them to be built, and only then can we see if the idea even works. Now, here's how I am going to use code layers. I can design a new feature in Figma and turn it into a working prototype right there on the canvas, then try two or three different versions and test them side by side. And the one that wins moves straight from design to product with the real code already there. What excites me most is speed. We can run our experiments way faster and launch working prototypes right from our designs. Curious how it all works? Just comment Figma and I'll DM you the link.
